paragraphs: Find email addresses for multiple contacts in one request (async). How it works: Submit up to 100 contacts with first_name, last_name, company_domain Receive a task_id immediately Poll GET endpoint with task_id to check status and retrieve results Limits: Maximum 100 contacts per batch Pricing: basic: 1.5 credits per found email premium: 5 credits per found email Only charged for emails found (not found = 0 credits)
